in_marathi.name: Indranil
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sky-blue, Indra's drop
in_marathi.long_meaning: Indranil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Indranil refers to the deep-blue color of the monsoon sky. It is also associated with Indra, the king of the gods in Hindu mythology. The name signifies power, strength, and courage.
